page.content:
Crewed lunar program that landed twelve astronauts between 1969 and 1972.

How Apollo program connects

  • Topic: NASA — The Apollo program was NASA's crewed lunar landing effort.
  • Event: Apollo 11 — Apollo 11 was the first landing mission of the Apollo program.
  • Item: Saturn V — Saturn V was the launch vehicle of the Apollo lunar missions.
  • Faction: Project Gemini — Apollo followed Gemini once rendezvous and EVA had been proven.
  • Faction: Artemis program — Artemis is NASA's later lunar-return program after Apollo.
  • Character: Katherine Johnson — Johnson also computed backup Apollo lunar-return paths at Langley.

What is Apollo program?

Apollo was NASA's Moon program: Saturn V, the command/service module, and the lunar module. Apollo 11 landed first; later flights explored Hadley, Descartes, and Taurus–Littrow.

Key threads lead to NASA, Apollo 11, Saturn V, Project Gemini, Artemis program and Katherine Johnson.
